error.title: Empty sub-folder in imagemain
error.description:
## Empty sub-folder(s) found
Empty sub-folder(s) were found inside "{root_group_name}": {empty_folders}
Empty groups block the layer merge used to produce the render and must be removed before publishing.
### How to repair?
You can fix this with the "Repair" button on the right, which will delete the empty sub-folder(s), then press the Refresh publishing button at the bottom right.
